purpose: Producer D3DX evaluation and bounded owned device-command batches with explicit GPU state restoration
timing_definition: Complete regular/extra GPU pairs in twelve rotated rounds. Native bulk is the original unhooked group prototype, not the whole installed beta renderer. Saved values are native minus worker per paired round; report median paired deltas.
discovery: Custom D3DX27 callbacks alone do not prevent automatic cached StateBlock Capture/Apply in this fixture. Direct replay hid interference that worker replay exposed. Audit now includes state-block child calls; flags=7 plus queued explicit flags=6 restoration passes while deliberate flags=6 evaluation fails the audit.
limits: Producer Begin now uses flags=7 (DONT SAVE) and returns its actual result/pass count; the worker explicitly restores the render-state/texture subset expected with flags=6. This is a changed effect-call contract, not proof that original Begin failure behavior is preserved.
Custom state callbacks report recording/admission status. Deferred driver failures abort the fixture; general native failure propagation or ordinary fallback is not implemented.

State-block audit patches the fixture driver implementation table shared by cached blocks; the automatic-save negative control proves that path is covered on each tested backend. Other device-child interfaces are not exhaustively audited.

Native compare/prepare/finish callbacks and material sources remain controlled. Fixed geometry, two already-warmed effects and one pass do not qualify arbitrary live assets, concurrent loading or full scene/Present.
Queued COM resources are AddRef/Release balanced and numeric values copied. Final device zero-reference release is checked only in the separate packet-reset regression, not the command harness.
Capture still traverses native per-mesh callbacks while the native bulk baseline suppresses qualified followers. This cost remains part of the candidate and must not be omitted from comparisons.
No installed change, gameplay FPS estimate, multiplayer proof or 60 FPS success claim.
next_boundary: Measure and reduce producer capture costs, including avoiding repeated native per-mesh dispatch in already-qualified bulk groups, before integrating full-scene commands or requesting gameplay.
